text: {"features":[{"name":"Role tailoring","description":"How specifically the letter connects the applicant's background and interests to the exact responsibilities and context of Google's Information Security Engineering role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter could fit many backend or security roles and refers to this team only at a surface level."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions Google or security impact in broad terms but maps the applicant to only one general aspect of the posting."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter connects the applicant to several stated elements of the role, such as security automation, Go backends, Python agents, or developer support."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter clearly aligns past work with multiple responsibilities in the posting and shows understanding of why this team exists."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter feels written for this exact role, tightly matching the applicant's experience to the team's mission, responsibilities, and operating context at Google."}]},{"name":"Security mindset","description":"How maturely the letter frames security as an engineering discipline centered on prevention, trust, and attacker-aware thinking.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter shows only generic interest in security or treats it mainly as a topic rather than an engineering discipline."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter expresses genuine security interest but gives limited articulation of how secure systems should be built or operated."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter presents a clear security perspective, such as prevention, trustworthy defaults, or reading code from an attacker's point of view."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter articulates a thoughtful security philosophy tied to system design, reliability, or embedding protections into development work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter conveys a distinctive, mature security worldview that makes the applicant sound already oriented toward this team's mission."}]},{"name":"Developer enablement","description":"How strongly the letter emphasizes helping other engineers work securely through tooling, defaults, and reduced friction.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter says little about serving other developers or improving their day-to-day work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions collaboration or internal users only in passing without a clear enablement angle."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter states an intention to help developers do the secure thing more easily or routinely."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows clear commitment to reducing friction for engineers through tooling, automation, or secure-by-default workflows."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter centers the case on enabling developers at scale and explicitly contrasts this with policing, paperwork, or heroics."}]},{"name":"Platform mindset","description":"How clearly the letter values foundational systems whose improvements benefit many teams rather than a single product surface.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives little sense of interest in central infrastructure or leverage across many teams."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter shows general excitement about scale but not about platform or multiplier effects."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter expresses interest in foundational or central systems as a meaningful part of the role."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter clearly describes the multiplier effect of platform work and why that type of leverage matters to the applicant."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter makes platform leverage a defining career motivation and persuasively ties it to security infrastructure at company scale."}]},{"name":"Production experience","description":"How strongly the letter establishes sustained hands-on experience testing, maintaining, and launching production software.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter establishes only minimal qualifying production experience, such as around three years and one or two launched services, with limited sense of scope."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter shows a few years of production work and some launches, but the overall scope still feels modest."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter presents solid mid-range production experience across multiple services with repeated maintenance and launch work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter demonstrates strong production depth through five or more years and several services with clear responsibility."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter establishes extensive production depth through long experience plus repeated launches or sustained stewardship across several services."}]},{"name":"Go depth","description":"How convincingly the letter shows the applicant can build the Go back-end systems central to the role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter mentions Go only briefly or as one language among many, with no sense of depth or centrality."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter shows some production use of Go but does not present it as a primary or role-defining language."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter indicates regular or primary use of Go in production services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter makes Go a clear daily driver for back-end engineering and ties it to meaningful system work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows deep, role-relevant Go ownership by pairing primary Go experience with concrete back-end or infrastructure responsibilities."}]},{"name":"Python depth","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates production-relevant Python experience for automation, services, or agents.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter does not mention Python or mentions it only indirectly."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter notes Python exposure without describing sustained or production use."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter describes regular Python use for tooling, automation, or services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows extensive Python use across production tooling or services and treats it as a core working language."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents Python as production-grade engineering work, such as typed or tested services, broadly used tooling, or central agent infrastructure."}]},{"name":"Agentic systems","description":"How much concrete experience the letter shows in designing or operating agent-based systems relevant to the role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter provides no evidence of agentic or agent-based system work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions automation or AI generally but not actual agent design."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter states experience building agent systems or agent-based tooling at a high level."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter describes a concrete agent architecture, typically with Python agents operating inside Go-defined permissions or guardrails."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter demonstrates substantial ownership of production agentic design by emphasizing autonomy, boundaries, auditability, and supporting infrastructure."}]},{"name":"Applied AI","description":"How convincingly the letter shows hands-on experience shipping AI features and managing their reliability in production.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no evidence of applied AI work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter signals interest in AI or mentions it only vaguely."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter describes shipping model-backed or LLM-backed functionality in real systems."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter goes beyond shipping to discuss reliability, failure modes, evaluation, or trustworthiness in production AI."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows strong applied AI judgment by combining shipped systems with explicit attention to safe deployment, hardening, or evaluation discipline."}]},{"name":"Security assessment","description":"How much concrete evidence the letter provides of performing structured security reviews or assessments.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no evidence of conducting security assessments or reviews."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter suggests a security-aware mindset but not actual assessment experience."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter states that the applicant has performed security assessments or reviews of systems."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter describes structured assessment work such as threat modeling, code review, or verification of remediations."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows repeated, hands-on assessment practice with attacker-aware reasoning or design-level analysis that goes beyond checklist work."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability automation","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates experience automating vulnerability intake, triage, routing, or related response workflows.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter does not mention vulnerability handling automation."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter expresses interest in security automation but gives no direct example of building it."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter mentions having automated vulnerability intake, triage, deduplication, or routing at a basic level."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter describes a concrete workflow or pipeline that reduced manual triage work for the team."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents vulnerability handling as a significant owned system, with clear automation of classification, prioritization, routing, or self-serve processing."}]},{"name":"Algorithmic fluency","description":"How well the letter demonstrates practical strength with data structures and algorithms.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no evidence of algorithmic or data-structure skill."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter makes only a generic claim about liking algorithms or working fluently with them."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter provides one concrete example of improving a system through a better algorithm or data structure."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows strong practical fluency through a substantial optimization or redesign on an important code path or workload."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter makes algorithmic thinking feel like a core strength through especially strong examples or repeated evidence of using it to simplify hard systems."}]},{"name":"Engineering rigor","description":"How strongly the letter signals disciplined engineering standards around correctness, guardrails, maintainability, and operational trustworthiness.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter provides little evidence of rigor beyond generic competence claims."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter uses broad words like reliable or serious without explaining practices that create rigor."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter gives some evidence of disciplined engineering, such as a maintainer mindset or attention to correctness."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter describes concrete rigor mechanisms such as explicit boundaries, auditability, typed or tested systems, or designing for inheritance by other teams."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter makes rigor a defining trait of the applicant and backs it with multiple concrete practices or examples that fit security-critical software."}]},{"name":"Evidence specificity","description":"How well the letter supports its claims with concrete examples, quantification, mechanisms, or outcomes.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter supports the case mainly with baseline facts such as degree or years, while most role-relevant strengths stay generic."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter adds a few concrete examples, but several important strengths remain asserted rather than shown."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter provides several concrete examples or quantified facts that make the central claims believable."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter regularly pairs claims with role-relevant details, mechanisms, or outcomes rather than general statements."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter makes nearly every major claim concrete through crisp examples, quantification, or clear causal detail."}]},{"name":"Open-source stewardship","description":"How much the letter shows meaningful engagement with open-source software as a contributor or maintainer.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter provides no evidence of open-source contribution."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions open source only as a user or as an occasional, lightly described contributor."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter describes occasional upstream bug fixes or patch submissions."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows regular contribution habits or maintainership of a project with ongoing responsibility."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter demonstrates clear stewardship, such as maintaining a project with users, releases, reviews, or community interaction."}]},{"name":"Technical initiative","description":"How strongly the letter shows self-directed technical building outside routine job responsibilities.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter describes no independent technical project or initiative."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions only a small, low-complexity side project with limited technical challenge."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter presents a completed personal project with some meaningful engineering substance."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows a substantial side project chosen to explore nontrivial systems behavior, failure cases, or infrastructure concerns."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter describes an ambitious, sustained independent build that tackles hard distributed-systems or reliability problems from first principles."}]},{"name":"Security practice","description":"How much the letter demonstrates hands-on security skill development beyond ordinary software work, such as competitions or certifications.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter provides no extra evidence of hands-on security practice outside day-to-day engineering claims."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter shows a light external signal, such as Security+ or casual mention of security practice."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter demonstrates meaningful additional practice through regular competition, a relevant certification, or similarly deliberate self-training."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter provides a strong external signal such as near-top competition finishes or a demanding practical certification like OSCP."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents security practice as an ongoing discipline with especially strong signals and a clear explanation of how it sharpens relevant skills."}]},{"name":"Organization","description":"How clearly the letter is structured, with ideas sequenced logically and each paragraph serving a clear purpose.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter reads mainly as a checklist or stack of claims with little narrative progression beyond basic formatting."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter has recognizable sections but the flow is uneven, repetitive, or mechanically sequenced."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter is generally easy to follow, though some connections feel routine or only loosely developed."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter is well organized, with a clear progression from motivation to evidence to close."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter is exceptionally coherent, with smooth transitions and a strong sense that every paragraph builds the overall case."}]},{"name":"Writing mechanics","description":"How polished the sentence-level writing is in spelling, grammar, and typographical accuracy.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter contains frequent noticeable errors that repeatedly distract from the message."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter contains several visible errors that reduce polish but do not block understanding."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter contains occasional errors, yet overall readability remains intact."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter contains only minor isolated slips in otherwise polished prose."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter is essentially error-free at the sentence level."}]},{"name":"Professional voice","description":"How persuasive, natural, and memorable the letter sounds as a professional self-presentation.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter maintains a generic or stiff tone that does little to make the applicant memorable."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter sounds professional but formulaic, with limited personality or rhetorical lift."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter sounds competent and readable, with some moments of engaged phrasing."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter sounds confident and natural, helping the applicant feel credible and interesting."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter has a distinctive, polished voice that is memorable without becoming showy."}]}]}
